OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.name: Campfire
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.descriptionP: Warm a creature card by the fire: it gains [gold]+1 Power[/gold] for the rest of the run.
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.descriptionH: Warm a creature card by the fire: it gains [gold]+2 Health[/gold] for the rest of the run.
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.descriptionD: You have no creature cards to warm.
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.promptPower: Choose a creature to gain +1 Power.
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.promptHealth: Choose a creature to gain +2 Health.
